hypothesis: Matched stored-action replay can expose different approach, lifting and transport trajectories between single and joint models, without new policy inference.
order: single40k then joint160k for each init3,0,12,13,14,6

observers.raw: Post-action bowl/plate/EEF XYZ, every contacting geometry-name pair, official native success and reward
observers.lift: Post-action bowl height >= post-wait initial bowl height +0.03m
observers.grasp: No grasp classification in this version; retain raw contact pairs for separate semantic validation

interpretation_gate: Only after full initial model/simulator digest and every robot-state/reward parity pass. Proxies are diagnostic, may be nonmonotone and do not establish causal interference or persistence.
failure: Stop entire chain at first error or mismatch, retain independent partial results, do not retry
